title: One finite stage for an affine piece over a common affine base open
statement: Let $I$ be a directed preorder, $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Scheme}$ an inverse system of schemes [def-pc-scheme] with affine transitions [pqf-def-affine-morphism], and $c$ a limiting cone [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition]. Let $i_0\le k$. Let $X_0,Y_0$ be schemes over $D(i_0)$ and $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ a morphism over that base [def-pc-fibre-product], locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Assume its base change $f_k$ to $D(k)$ is affine. Let $V\subseteq Y_0$ and $W\subseteq D(i_0)$ be affine opens [lem-weil-pbc-affine-open-spec-points] with $V\subseteq(Y_0\to D(i_0))^{-1}(W)$. Denote the base changes by $f_i,f$ and their first target projections by $p_{i0},p_0$. If $f|_{p_0^{-1}(V)}$ is finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], there exist $j\ge k$ for which $f_j|_{p_{j0}^{-1}(V)}$ is finite. Only one stage is asserted here; persistence at later stages is proved separately by base change.

proof.text: Transport finiteness of the limit restriction across its arrow isomorphism. The finite-Spec criterion gives finiteness of id tensor phi over colim F. The upper tail is directed: a common upper bound of two indices is still above k. Apply the finite-ring-map colimit descent lemma at its least element to get one stage with finite id tensor phi. The finite-Spec criterion and the corresponding stage arrow isomorphism give the required finite restriction.

theorem exists_isFinite_morphismRestrict_baseChange_affine_base_piece
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u})
    [∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (g : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map g)]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c) (i₀ k : I) (hk : i₀ ≤ k)
    (X₀ Y₀ : Over (D.obj (op i₀))) (f₀ : X₀ ⟶ Y₀)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f₀.left]
    (haffine : IsAffineHom (((Over.pullback (D.map (homOfLE hk).op)).map f₀).left))
    (V : Y₀.left.Opens) (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    (W : (D.obj (op i₀)).Opens) (hW : IsAffineOpen W)
    (hVW : V ≤ Y₀.hom ⁻¹ᵁ W)
    (hfinite : IsFinite
      ((((Over.pullback (c.π.app (op i₀))).map f₀).left) ∣_
        ((pullback.fst Y₀.hom (c.π.app (op i₀))) ⁻¹ᵁ V))) :
    ∃ (j : I) (hkj : k ≤ j),
      IsFinite
        ((((Over.pullback (D.map (homOfLE (hk.trans hkj)).op)).map f₀).left)
          ∣_ ((pullback.fst Y₀.hom (D.map (homOfLE (hk.trans hkj)).op)) ⁻¹ᵁ V))
